edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the token movement.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance deduction.
Constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender().
manualswap authorization compares msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization compares msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
Cooldown comparison and assignment use block.timestamp in _transfer.
Swap deadline is derived from block.timestamp.
Liquidity deadline and pair setup use block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping.
from parameter flows into the transfer logic and blacklist checks.
to parameter flows into the transfer logic and cooldown checks.
amount parameter flows into transfer and max-tx checks.
tAmount parameter drives the reflection value computation.
tokenAmount parameter is swapped through the router.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
notbot parameter is written into the bots mapping.
contractTokenBalance local feeds the conditional swap in _transfer.
contractETHBalance local feeds the conditional ETH payout in _transfer.
path local array is passed to the router swap call.
currentRate local is used to convert team fee into reflections.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for the swap call.
openTrading writes and uses uniswapV2Router.
openTrading writes uniswapV2Pair after createPair.
sendETHToFee pays _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee pays _feeAddrWallet2.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, altering the reflection supply.
bots mapping gates whether a transfer is permitted.
inSwap flag guards against nested swap execution.
swapEnabled flag gates the automatic swap branch.
cooldownEnabled flag gates the cooldown branch.
_maxTxAmount limits the transfer amount on buys.
owner comparison exempts owner from fee and bot logic.
_rOwned balances are debited and credited in _transferStandard.
transferFrom reads and updates the allowance mapping.
_transfer calls the internal _tokenTransfer wrapper.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current reflection rate.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team fee.
_transfer performs an external router swap before balances are settled.
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets, invoking external addresses.
swapTokensForEth triggers the router swap external call.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the external router.
openTrading calls createPair on the external factory.
The external router can re-enter the swap flow before inSwap state is restored.
ETH transfer to a payable wallet can re-enter the contract via receive().
ETH transfer to the second payable wallet can re-enter the contract.
Factory createPair callback can re-enter openTrading before tradingOpen is set.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to drive the core _transfer logic and its blacklist/cooldown checks.
The to parameter is only consumed by _transfer for cooldown and fee-branch decisions.
The amount parameter is only validated and forwarded inside _transfer.
tAmount is the sole input of _transferStandard amount computation.
tokenAmount is only used as the router swap input inside swapTokensForEth.
bots_ array is only iterated to populate the bots mapping inside setBots.
notbot is only used to clear a blacklist entry in delBot.
onoff is only assigned to cooldownEnabled in setCooldownEnabled.
The local balance snapshot only feeds the swap branch of _transfer.
The local ETH balance is only used as the amount handed to sendETHToFee.
The path array is only constructed to serve the router swap call.
currentRate is only computed and used inside _takeTeam for reflection conversion.
